corrections.subject: 00F8A8BC
corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md: an unresolved overlap; either 009FFC80's slots 3..6 are unreachable or the shipped build writes out of bounds
corrections.is: the array is three floats wide and slots 3..6 are out of bounds; 00A360F5 guards the loader's store with CMP EDI,3 / JGE, while AISetDefendResourcePercent (00A37E4B) and the read at 00A29C38 both index it with 009FFC80's 0..6
corrections.evidence: 00A360F5 CMP EDI,3 / JGE 00A3613E; 00A36126 FSTP [EDI*4+0F8A8BCh]; loop bound XOR EDI,EDI at 00A3374B and CMP EDI,7 at 00A370D7; base of the 1Ch array proven at 00A25C06..00A25C23; all seven shipped sub-tables carry Defend_ResourcePercent

corrections.evidence: 00A32500's identity comparison at 00A32530..00A32570 and the match loop of 00A31DB0; FLD float ptr [EDI+0Ch] at 00A31EC2

corrections.subject: 00A31DB0 relative rules
corrections.is: the relative arm re-enters 00A08460 with the identical query instead of the rule's reference pair at +14h/+18h/+1Ch, which it never reads; the memo entry is written only after the computation, so a matching relative rule recurses without bound
corrections.evidence: 00A31EA9..00A31EB7 reads [ESP+10h], [ESP+18h], [ESP+28h] and EBX, all written once in the prologue at 00A31DB6/00A31DBA/00A31DE8/00A31DED; no read of EDI+14h, EDI+18h or EDI+1Ch anywhere in 00A31DB0
